name: codex-paired-superpowers
description: Claude Code plugin for multi-agent, cross-model software engineering. Claude pairs with Codex (and optionally Gemini through the agy CLI) to brainstorm, plan, implement and review: Codex writes the code by default, Claude reviews first, and nothing ships until every reviewer approves the same version. Optional review panels require unanimous agreement; runs are resumable and checkpointed. Inspired by obra/superpowers.
